d: RJD neta Tejashwi Yadav ne pradhanmantri Narendra Modi ke 'dimagi naksali' vale bayan par palatvar kiya. unhonne saval uthaya ki Gen Z aur Gen Alpha ko is tarah sanbodhit karne ke bajay sarkar berojgari aur mahangaee jaise muddon par javab kyon nahin deti. tejasvi ne bihar men phaiktriyan nahin lagae jane ko lekar bhi PM Modi se saval kiya.
